attempts.why: Add explicit details:not([open])> *:not(summary){display:none} in accordion component to restore UA hiding that was overridden by dropdown open descendant display rules, so closed nested accordions stay hidden inside open dropdown.

selfVerify.reason: #accp is now display:none with 0x0 box while #acc has no open attribute inside open #dd, so nested accordion closed-state hiding is restored; dropdown ul remains flex visible and no other layout broken.

pick.suspected: Nested accordion panel #accp visible while its <details id=acc> is closed (no open) inside open dropdown <details.dropdown open#dd>. Dropdown open rule (details[open]>ul display:flex/block plus descendant display override) overrides UA `details:not([open])>:not(summary){display:none}` and Pico accordion closed-state hiding in _accordion.scss, so closed details content is forced to display:block instead of display:none.
